arxiv-1902-08686.title: RAMHU: A New Robust Lightweight Scheme for Mutual Users Authentication in Healthcare Applications
arxiv-1902-08686.creator: Mishall Al-Zubaidie, Zhongwei Zhang, Ji Zhang
arxiv-1902-08686.description: Abstract Abstract- Providing a mechanism to authenticate users in healthcare applications is an essential security requirement to prevent both external and internal attackers from penetrating patients’ identities and revealing their health data. Many schemes have been developed to provide authentication mechanisms to ensure that only legitimate users are authorized to connect, but these schemes still suffer from vulnerable security.

arxiv-2003-06278.title: Default Bayes Factors for Testing the (In)equality of Several Population Variances
arxiv-2003-06278.creator: Fabian Dablander, Don van den Bergh, Eric-Jan Wagenmakers, Alexander Ly
arxiv-2003-06278.description: Abstract Testing the (in)equality of variances is an important problem in many statistical applications. We develop default Bayes factor tests to assess the (in)equality of two or more population variances, as well as a test for whether the population variances equal a specific value.

arxiv-2007-03484.title: Gravitational dark matter production in Palatini preheating
arxiv-2007-03484.creator: Alexandros Karam, Martti Raidal, and Eemeli Tomberg
arxiv-2007-03484.description: Abstract We study preheating in plateau inflation in the Palatini formulation of general relativity, in a special case that resembles Higgs inflation. It was previously shown that the oscillating inflaton field returns to the plateau repeatedly in this model, and this leads to tachyonic production of inflaton particles.

arxiv-2204-09731.title: Magnetic field strength from turbulence theory (I): Using differential measure approach (DMA) Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2204-09731.creator: A. Lazarian, Ka Ho Yuen, Dmitri Pogosyan
arxiv-2204-09731.description: Abstract The mean plane-of-sky magnetic field strength is traditionally obtained from the combination of polarization and spectroscopic data using the Davis-Chandrasekhar-Fermi (DCF) technique. However, we identify the major problem of the DCF to be its disregard of the anisotropic character of MHD turbulence.

arxiv-2301-12898.title: A Role of Fractional Dimension in Study Physics Journal: osac Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2301-12898.description: Abstract This study has two parts. In part A , we explore the field of physics through the lens of fractional dimensionality. We propose that space is not confined to integer dimensions alone but can also be understood as a superposition of spaces that exist between these integer dimensions.

arxiv-2304-03512.title: Hierarchical Catalogue Generation for Literature Review: A Benchmark
arxiv-2304-03512.creator: Kun Zhu, Xiaocheng Feng, Xiachong Feng, Yingsheng Wu, Bing Qin
arxiv-2304-03512.description: Abstract Scientific literature review generation aims to extract and organize important information from an abundant collection of reference papers and produces corresponding reviews while lacking a clear and logical hierarchy. We observe that a high-quality catalogue-guided generation process can effectively alleviate this problem.

arxiv-2310-10634.title: OpenAgents : An Open Platform for Language Agents in the Wild
arxiv-2310-10634.creator: Tianbao Xie ♠ ♢ Fan Zhou ∗ ♠ ♢ Zhoujun Cheng ∗ ♠ ♢ Peng Shi ∗ ♢ Luoxuan Weng ∗ ♢ Yitao Liu ∗ ♠ ♢ Toh Jing Hua ♢ Junning Zhao ♢ Qian Liu ♡ ♢ Che Liu ♢ Leo Z. Liu ♢ Yiheng Xu ♠ ♢ Hongjin Su ♠ ♢ Dongchan Shin ♠ ♢ Caiming Xiong ♣ Tao Yu ♠ ♢ ♠ The University of Hong Kong ♢ XLang Lab ♡ Sea AI Lab ♣ Salesf
arxiv-2310-10634.description: Abstract Language agents show potential in being capable of utilizing natural language for varied and intricate tasks in diverse environments, particularly when built upon large language models (LLMs). Current language agent frameworks aim to facilitate the construction of proof-of-concept language agents while neglecting the non-expert user access to agents and paying little attention to application-level designs.

arxiv-2503-06323.title: Higher-Order Belief in Incomplete Information MAIDs
arxiv-2503-06323.creator: Jack Foxabbott, Rohan Subramani, Francis Rhys Ward
arxiv-2503-06323.description: Abstract . Multi-agent influence diagrams (MAIDs) are probabilistic graphical models which represent strategic interactions between agents. MAIDs are equivalent to extensive form games (EFGs) but have a more compact and informative structure. However, MAIDs cannot, in general, represent settings of incomplete information — wherein agents have different beliefs about the game being played, and different beliefs about each-other’s beliefs.

arxiv-2505-09153.title: Neutrino Fluence influenced by Memory Burdened Primordial Black Holes
arxiv-2505-09153.creator: Arnab Chaudhuri, Koushik Pal, Rukmani Mohanta
arxiv-2505-09153.description: Abstract Primordial black holes (PBHs), formed in the early Universe, are capable of emitting both Standard Model (SM) and beyond-the-Standard-Model (BSM) particles via Hawking radiation. We investigate the impact of the recently proposed memory burden effect—a quantum gravitational backreaction that suppresses black hole evaporation once approximately half the PBH mass is lost—on the production of high-energy neutrinos.

arxiv-2505-20707.title: Dissecting Physics Reasoning in Small Language Models: A Multi-Dimensional Analysis from an Educational Perspective
arxiv-2505-20707.creator: Nicy Scaria, Silvester John Joseph Kennedy, Krishna Agarwal
arxiv-2505-20707.description: Abstract Small Language Models (SLMs) offer privacy and efficiency for educational deployment, yet their utility depends on reliable multi-step reasoning. Existing benchmarks often prioritize final-answer accuracy, obscuring ‘right answer, wrong procedure’ failures that can reinforce student misconceptions. This work investigates SLM physics reasoning reliability, stage-wise failure modes, and robustness under paired contextual rewrites.

arxiv-2507-11279.title: Scientific Data Descriptor Tomato Multi-Angle Multi-Pose Dataset for Fine-Grained Phenotyping
arxiv-2507-11279.creator: Yujie Zhang, Sabine Struckmeyer, Andreas Kolb, Sven Reichardt
arxiv-2507-11279.description: Abstract Observer bias and inconsistencies in traditional plant phenotyping methods limit the accuracy and reproducibility of fine-grained plant analysis. To overcome these challenges, we developed TomatoMAP, a comprehensive dataset for Solanum lycopersicum using an Internet of Things (IoT) based imaging system with standardized data acquisition protocols.

arxiv-2606-10959.creator: Batu Candan, Simone Servadio

britannica-1911-souham-joseph-count.title: Souham, Joseph, Count (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-souham-joseph-count.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-souham-joseph-count.description: Article 'Souham, Joseph, Count' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. born at Lubersac on the 30th of April 1760, and served in the French army as a private from 1782 to 1790. In 1792, having shown himself active in the cause of the Revolution, he was elected commandant of a volunteer battalion, and by 1793 he had risen to the rank of general of division.

pmc-10529620.title: Modification of Acorn Starch Structure and Properties by High Hydrostatic Pressure
pmc-10529620.creator: Luís M. G. Castro, Ana I. Caço, Carla F. Pereira, Sérgio C. Sousa, María E. Brassesco, Manuela Machado, Óscar L. Ramos, Elisabete M. C. Alexandre, Jorge A. Saraiva, Manuela Pintado
pmc-10529620.description: Despite being rich in starch, over half of acorn production is undervalued. High hydrostatic pressure was used to modify the properties of Q. pyrenaica (0.1 and 460 MPa for 20 min) and Q. robur (0.1 and 333 MPa for 17.4 min) acorn starches to obtain high-valued ingredients.

pmc-11473621.title: Kinetic analysis of D-Alanine upon oral intake in humans
pmc-11473621.creator: Tomonori Kimura, Shinsuke Sakai, Masaru Horio, Shiro Takahara, Shoto Ishigo, Maiko Nakane, Eiichi Negishi, Hiroshi Imoto, Masashi Mita, Kenji Hamase, Yoko Higa-Maekawa, Yoichi Kakuta, Masayuki Mizui, Yoshitaka Isaka
pmc-11473621.description: D-Alanine, a rare enantiomer of alanine, can potentially alleviate the worsening of viral infections and maintain circadian rhythm. This study aimed to analyze the kinetics of D-Alanine upon oral intake. Five healthy volunteers were administered D-Alanine as a single oral dose at 11,236 or 33,708 µmoL (1–3 g).

pmc-11608867.title: Expanding subcutaneous mass on the scalp of an immunocompromised woman
pmc-11608867.creator: Ivan Rodriguez, Karen Lam, Simone Montgomery, Shanice McKenzie, Scott Worswick
pmc-11608867.description: Acute cutaneous presentations in immunocompromised patients demand careful and thorough evaluation. Here, we present the case of a 26‐year‐old female with acute myeloid leukaemia undergoing salvage chemotherapy, who developed an acutely expanding subcutaneous mass starting on the frontotemporal scalp to the angle of the jaw. Histopathologic evaluation was consistent with sclerosing fat necrosis with overlying psoriasiform spongiotic dermatitis.

pmc-11635337.title: Effects of a Digital Therapeutic Adjunct to Eating Disorder Treatment on Health Care Service Utilization and Clinical Outcomes: Retrospective Observational Study Using Electronic Health Records
pmc-11635337.creator: Jorge E Palacios, Kathryn K Erickson-Ridout, Jane Paik Kim, Stuart Buttlaire, Samuel Ridout, Stuart Argue, Jenna Tregarthen, John Torous, Gemma Sharp, Janet Franklin
pmc-11635337.description: BackgroundThe need for scalable solutions facilitating access to eating disorder (ED) treatment services that are efficient, effective, and inclusive is a major public health priority. Remote access to synchronous and asynchronous support delivered via health apps has shown promise, but results are so far mixed, and there are limited data on whether apps can enhance health care utilization.

pmc-11653812.title: Evaluation of the social-economic impacts of hyena attacks on humans and livestock in the Nyang’whale district of Tanzania
pmc-11653812.creator: Noela Samwel Hello, Rosemary Peter Mramba, Doreen Jeremiah Mrimi
pmc-11653812.description: BackgroundThe spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta) is one of the carnivore species that frequently comes into conflict with humans. These conflicts are attributed to their scavenging foraging behaviour and their ability to occupy habitats close to human settlements. In Tanzania, the Geita region has recently experienced an increase in livestock and human attacks by hyenas.

pmc-12656126.title: Geometrical Optimal Navigation and Path Planning—Bridging Theory, Algorithms, and Applications
pmc-12656126.creator: Hedieh Jafarpourdavatgar, Samaneh Alsadat Saeedinia, Mahsa Mohaghegh
pmc-12656126.description: Autonomous systems, such as self-driving cars, surgical robots, and space rovers, require efficient and collision-free navigation in dynamic environments. Geometric optimal navigation and path planning have become critical research areas, combining geometry, optimization, and machine learning to address these challenges.

pmc-12835000.title: Quantitative paleoclimate reconstruction in the Yangtze River Delta since the Last Glacial Maximum based on pollen records
pmc-12835000.creator: Feng Chen, Xue Ke, Tinglu Yang, Zongyan Zhang, Ren Jiang, Junjie Yu, Jianlei Xie, Jing Li
pmc-12835000.description: The climate dynamics and driving mechanisms of the East Asian Summer Monsoon (EASM) in the Yangtze River Delta (YRD) since the Last Glacial Maximum (LGM) remain uncertain. We reconstruct annual mean temperature (Tann), mean temperature of the warmest month (MTwa), and annual mean precipitation (Pann) since 19.

pmc-13068612.title: Gut microbiota-derived cholic acid ameliorates lung inflammation in bronchopulmonary dysplasia through modulation of macrophage function
pmc-13068612.creator: Dongying Zhao, Caixia Gao, Danying Zhu, Xiaoyan Zheng, Jiping Sun, Chengbo Liu, Lei Chen, Lei Shen, Xingyun Wang, Yongjun Zhang
pmc-13068612.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryThis study explores the impact of gut microbiota-derived metabolites on the pathogenesis of bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD), focusing on their roles in macrophage plasticity and inflammation. In a prospective nested case-control cohort of 30 infants with BPD and 33 preterm controls, 16S ribosomal RNA (16S rRNA) and mass spectrometry analyses identified seven differential gut bacterial genera, with depleted Streptococcus and enriched Klebsiella in patients with BPD, alongside reduced fecal and serum cholic acid levels.

pmc-13159224.title: Electronegative electroretinography in inherited retinal disease: a systematic review of genotype–phenotype correlations
pmc-13159224.creator: Ibrahim Taha, Khalil Huraibat, Liana Al-Labadi
pmc-13159224.description: BackgroundThe electronegative electroretinogram (ERG)—in which the dark-adapted bright-flash b-wave amplitude falls below the a-wave (b: a ratio < 1.0)—localizes dysfunction to the inner retina or photoreceptor–bipolar synapse. In inherited retinal disease (IRD), this waveform has been associated with a restricted set of genetic etiologies, but the evidence has not been systematically synthesized.

pmc-13254363.title: Arab gum coating enhances the bioavailability and therapeutic potential of nanoselenium in cisplatin-induced testicular toxicity
pmc-13254363.creator: Samar Abdelbaset, Mai Alaa El-Dein, Mahmoud M. Zakaria, Amira Awadalla, Amoura M. Abou-El-Naga

pmc-13448117.title: Exploring the correlation between psychological indicators and professional sports performance athletes through virtual reality training
pmc-13448117.creator: Xu Ran
pmc-13448117.description: This study examines the relationship between psychological indicators and performance outcomes, and explored changes in motor performance during a training period incorporating virtual reality (VR)-based components. The sample consisted of 100 student boxers (65 men and 35 women) aged 18 years or over. A single-group pre–post design was employed over a six-month training period.
